notReady: Go around and discover everything the town has to offer, dear. Then the party is waiting for you. Wheek!
ready: Wheek! Everything's ready. Everyone in town is waiting to celebrate you!
started: Wonderful! Everyone's waiting at Seoul Food KBBQ in Koreatown.
Go on ahead, dear. I'll be right behind you. Guinea pig legs are short.

dialogue: SURPRISE! Everyone in town is here, and they saved you the best seat.
Momo fires up the grill. Happy birthday, Zuzu!
Try the food, and don't forget: there's a present with your name on it.
revisitDialogue: Seoul Food KBBQ is back to business as usual. The grill's still hot, and there's always a seat for you.
The house special is grilling it yourself: halal belly strips, pickles only, and every tenth grill is on the house.

dialogue: Happy birthday, dear! Rent: paid. Heart: full.

foodInteractions.name: Birthday BBQ
foodInteractions.description: The grill sizzles away, surrounded by a whole parade of little side dishes. There's room for everyone. (Fun fact: the creator of this game doesn't know what any of it is called either. He just eats it and shuts up.)

foodInteractions.name: Macarona & Chicken Pané
foodInteractions.description: Tomato-sauce pasta and crispy breaded chicken. Of course we made room for this, too.

grill.name: Grill it yourself (halal belly strips)
grill.line: Momo sets down a tray of raw halal belly and hands Zu the tongs. "Your grill, your rules."

gift.label: A present for you
dialogue: A little wrapped present with your name on it. Inside is a letter.

giftReminder: Wait! Ms. Pumpkin points at the end of the table. There's still a present with your name on it.
farewell: What a night. Everyone waves as you head back out into town.
Your letter is in your mailbox now, whenever you want to read it again.
Go ahead and enjoy Zutopia! There is lots to discover still. Also, life is about to get very real...
